question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Give the name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*p.price) DESC, c.id LIMIT 1
generated:
```sql
SELECT c.name AS customer_name
FROM customers c
JOIN (
    SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_spender ON c.id = top_spender.customer_id;
```
